fields.name: Swap file
fields.description: Creates, activates and adds a swap file to /etc/fstab; unchanged when it exists with that size. Refuses file systems that cannot hold swap.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Creates and activates a swap file and adds it to /etc/fstab; nothing changes when it already exists with that size.
# Variables: SIZE_MB (required, 64-1048576), SWAP_PATH (default /swapfile).
# Exit codes: 0 swap in place, 1 failed, 3 bad input or the file system cannot hold swap.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

size=${SIZE_MB:-}
sp=${SWAP_PATH:-/swapfile}
case $size in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "SIZE_MB must be a whole number"; exit 3 ;; esac
[ ${#size} -le 7 ] && [ "$size" -ge 64 ] && [ "$size" -le 1048576 ] || { echo "SIZE_MB must be 64-1048576"; exit 3; }
case $sp in /*) ;; *) echo "SWAP_PATH must be an absolute path"; exit 3 ;; esac
case $sp in *..* | *//* | *[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*) echo "SWAP_PATH has characters that are not allowed"; exit 3 ;; esac
dir=$(dirname "$sp")
[ -d "$dir" ] || { echo "Directory $dir does not exist"; exit 3; }
[ -L "$sp" ] && { echo "$sp is a symlink"; exit 3; }
for t in mkswap swapon; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$t not found: install util-linux"; exit 3; }; done

fs=$(stat -f -c %T "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
case $fs in
tmpfs | overlay* | nfs* | smb* | cifs | zfs | ramfs | fuse*) echo "A swap file cannot live on the $fs file system"; exit 3 ;;
btrfs) command -v chattr >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "btrfs needs chattr (e2fsprogs) to disable copy-on-write for the swap file"; exit 3; } ;;
esac
active() { awk -v p="$sp" -v kb=$((size * 1024)) 'NR>1 && $1==p && $3>=kb-64 && $3<=kb {f=1} END {exit !f}' /proc/swaps; }
bytes=$((size * 1048576))
if [ -e "$sp" ]; then
  [ -f "$sp" ] || { echo "$sp exists and is not a regular file"; exit 3; }
  have=$(stat -c %s "$sp" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$have" != "$bytes" ]; then echo "$sp exists with a different size ($((have / 1048576)) MB); remove it first"; exit 3; fi
  chmod 600 "$sp"
  created=
else
  avail=$(df -Pm "$dir" | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
  [ "${avail:-0}" -ge $((size + 256)) ] || { echo "Not enough free space on $dir: ${avail:-0} MB free, need $((size + 256)) MB"; exit 3; }
  : >"$sp" && chmod 600 "$sp" || exit 1
  created=1
  if [ "$fs" = btrfs ]; then chattr +C "$sp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$sp"; echo "chattr +C failed"; exit 1; }; fi
  case $fs in ext4 | xfs) command -v fallocate >/dev/null 2>&1 && fallocate -l "${size}M" "$sp" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *) false ;; esac ||
    dd if=/dev/zero of="$sp" bs=1M count="$size" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$sp"; echo "Creating $sp failed"; exit 1; }
  chmod 600 "$sp"
  mkswap "$sp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$sp"; echo "mkswap failed"; exit 1; }
fi
did=
if ! active; then
  if ! swapon "$sp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    [ -n "$created" ] && rm -f "$sp"
    echo "swapon failed (insufficient privileges, as in a container, or a file system without swap support)"
    exit 1
  fi
  did="activated"
fi
if ! awk -v p="$sp" '$1==p && $3=="swap" {f=1} END {exit !f}' /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null; then
  # a last line without newline would swallow the new entry
  [ -s /etc/fstab ] && [ -n "$(tail -c1 /etc/fstab)" ] && printf '\n' >>/etc/fstab
  printf '%s none swap sw 0 0\n' "$sp" >>/etc/fstab && did="${did:+$did, }fstab entry added"
fi
active || { echo "$sp is not active after the change"; exit 1; }
if [ -n "$did" ]; then echo "Swap file $sp (${size} MB): ${created:+created, }$did"; else echo "Swap file $sp (${size} MB) already in place"; fi
exit 0

variables.help: 64 or more.
variables.name: SIZE_MB
variables.label: Size (MB)

variables.help: Absolute path of the swap file.
variables.name: SWAP_PATH
variables.label: File path

fields.name: Time synchronisation
fields.description: Makes sure systemd-timesyncd or chrony runs and starts at boot; installs chrony only on request.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Makes sure time synchronisation runs (systemd-timesyncd or chrony); installs chrony only when asked.
# Variables: INSTALL (default false, install chrony when no time service exists).
# Exit codes: 0 time sync running, 1 failed, 3 bad input or no time service and INSTALL is false.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

inst=${INSTALL:-false}
case $inst in true | false) ;; *) echo "INSTALL must be true or false"; exit 3 ;; esac
svc=
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
  for u in chrony chronyd systemd-timesyncd ntpsec ntp ntpd; do
    systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && svc=$u && break
  done
  if [ -z "$svc" ] && [ "$inst" = true ]; then
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y chrony >/dev/null 2>&1
    elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf -y install chrony >/dev/null 2>&1
    elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum -y install chrony >/dev/null 2>&1
    elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then zypper -n install chrony >/dev/null 2>&1
    elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -S --needed --noconfirm chrony >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "pacman failed; if the package databases are stale, run a full upgrade (pacman -Syu) first"
    fi
    for u in chrony chronyd; do systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && svc=$u && break; done
  fi
  [ -n "$svc" ] || { echo "No time service installed; set INSTALL to true to install chrony"; exit 3; }
  systemctl enable "$svc" >/dev/null 2>&1
  systemctl start "$svc" >/dev/null 2>&1
  [ "$svc" = systemd-timesyncd ] && timedatectl set-ntp true >/dev/null 2>&1
  if ! systemctl is-active "$svc" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$(systemctl show "$svc" -p ConditionResult --value 2>/dev/null)" = no ]; then
      echo "$svc is skipped here by its unit conditions (for example inside a container)"
      exit 3
    fi
    echo "$svc is not running"
    exit 1
  fi
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in chronyd ntpd; do [ -f "/etc/init.d/$u" ] && svc=$u && break; done
  if [ -z "$svc" ] && [ "$inst" = true ] && command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add chrony >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -f /etc/init.d/chronyd ] && svc=chronyd
  fi
  [ -n "$svc" ] || { echo "No time service installed; set INSTALL to true to install chrony"; exit 3; }
  rc-update add "$svc" default >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc-service "$svc" start >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc-service "$svc" status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$svc is not running"; exit 1; }
else
  echo "Neither systemd nor OpenRC found"
  exit 3
fi
echo "Time synchronisation running with $svc"
exit 0

variables.help: Install chrony when no time service exists.
variables.name: INSTALL
variables.label: Install chrony

fields.name: Time zone
fields.description: Shows the time zone, or sets it. Exit 3 when the zone is unknown or tzdata is missing.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Shows the time zone, or sets it.
# Variables: TIMEZONE (optional, e.g. Europe/Berlin, empty = only report).
# Exit codes: 0 done, 1 failed, 3 bad input or tzdata missing.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

tz=${TIMEZONE:-}
cur() {
  if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v timedatectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    timedatectl show -p Timezone --value 2>/dev/null && return
  fi
  l=$(readlink /etc/localtime 2>/dev/null)
  case $l in *zoneinfo/*) echo "${l#*zoneinfo/}" ;; *) cat /etc/timezone 2>/dev/null || echo UTC ;; esac
}
if [ -z "$tz" ]; then
  echo "Time zone: $(cur), local time $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')"
  exit 0
fi
case $tz in -* | /* | *..* | *[!A-Za-z0-9_+/-]*) echo "TIMEZONE has characters that are not allowed"; exit 3 ;; esac
[ ${#tz} -le 64 ] || { echo "TIMEZONE is too long"; exit 3; }
[ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$tz" ] || { echo "Time zone $tz not found in /usr/share/zoneinfo (install tzdata if the directory is missing)"; exit 3; }
if [ "$(cur)" = "$tz" ]; then
  echo "Time zone already $tz"
  exit 0
fi
old=$(cur)
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v timedatectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  timedatectl set-timezone "$tz" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "timedatectl failed"; exit 1; }
else
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$tz" /etc/localtime || exit 1
  [ -d /etc ] && printf '%s\n' "$tz" >/etc/timezone
fi
[ "$(cur)" = "$tz" ] || { echo "Time zone is $(cur) after the change"; exit 1; }
echo "Time zone changed from $old to $tz"
exit 0

variables.help: For example Europe/Berlin. Empty only reports.
variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.label: Time zone

fields.name: Automatic security updates
fields.description: Shows, enables or disables unattended security updates: unattended-upgrades on apt systems, dnf-automatic on dnf systems. Exit 3 on zypper, pacman and apk with the reason.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Shows, enables or disables automatic security updates (unattended-upgrades on apt, dnf-automatic on dnf).
# Variables: STATE (status, enable, disable; default status).
# Exit codes: 0 ok (status: enabled), 1 failed or status disabled, 3 bad input or unsupported package manager.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

st=${STATE:-status}
case $st in status | enable | disable) ;; *) echo "STATE must be status, enable or disable"; exit 3 ;; esac
sysd=
[ -d /run/systemd/system ] && sysd=1

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  conf=/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades
  have() { dpkg -s unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^Status: install ok installed'; }
  val() { apt-config shell v APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^v='\(.*\)'/\1/"; }
  if [ "$st" = status ]; then
    # a disabled or masked apt-daily-upgrade.timer means unattended-upgrades never runs
    if have && [ "$(val)" = 1 ] && { [ -z "$sysd" ] || systemctl is-enabled apt-daily-upgrade.timer >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then echo "Automatic security updates: enabled (unattended-upgrades)"; exit 0; fi
    echo "Automatic security updates: disabled"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$st" = enable ]; then
    have || { DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y unattended-upgrades >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Could not install unattended-upgrades"; exit 1; }; }
    printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";\n' >"$conf"
    [ -n "$sysd" ] && systemctl enable --now apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ "$(val)" = 1 ] && have && { echo "Automatic security updates enabled (unattended-upgrades, $conf)"; exit 0; }
    echo "Enabling did not take effect"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -f "$conf" ] || have; then
    printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "0";\n' >"$conf"
  fi
  [ "$(val)" = 1 ] && { echo "Could not disable, another apt.conf.d file sets it"; exit 1; }
  echo "Automatic security updates disabled"
  exit 0
fi

if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if dnf --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q '^dnf5'; then pkg=dnf5-plugin-automatic timer=dnf5-automatic.timer
  else pkg=dnf-automatic timer=dnf-automatic-install.timer; fi
  timers="$timer dnf-automatic.timer"
  conf=/etc/dnf/automatic.conf
  # the -install timer always applies updates, the plain ones only with apply_updates = yes
  on() {
    [ -n "$sysd" ] || return 1
    for t in $timers; do
      systemctl is-enabled "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
      [ "$t" = dnf-automatic-install.timer ] && return 0
      grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*apply_updates[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*(yes|True|true)' "$conf" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    done
    return 1
  }
  if [ "$st" = status ]; then
    if on; then echo "Automatic security updates: enabled ($timer)"; exit 0; fi
    echo "Automatic security updates: disabled"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$st" = enable ]; then
    [ -n "$sysd" ] || { echo "systemd is not running, cannot schedule $timer"; exit 3; }
    [ -f "$conf" ] || dnf -y install "$pkg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Could not install $pkg"; exit 1; }
    command -v dnf-automatic >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -f "$conf" ] || { echo "$pkg did not install"; exit 1; }
    [ -f "$conf" ] || printf '[commands]\n' >"$conf"
    for kv in "upgrade_type = security" "apply_updates = yes"; do
      k=${kv%% *}
      if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*${k}[[:space:]]*=" "$conf"; then sed -i "s/^[[:space:]]*${k}[[:space:]]*=.*/$kv/" "$conf"
      else sed -i "/^\[commands\]/a $kv" "$conf"; fi
    done
    systemctl enable --now "$timer" >/dev/null 2>&1
    on && { echo "Automatic security updates enabled ($timer, security only, $conf)"; exit 0; }
    echo "Enabling did not take effect"
    exit 1
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  [ -n "$sysd" ] && systemctl disable --now $timers >/dev/null 2>&1
  on && { echo "Could not disable $timers"; exit 1; }
  echo "Automatic security updates disabled"
  exit 0
fi

for pm in zypper pacman apk; do
  command -v "$pm" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
  case $pm in
  zypper) why="openSUSE has no supported unattended security update tool (use a transactional-update timer or a maintenance script)" ;;
  pacman) why="Arch must not update unattended: partial or blind upgrades break the system" ;;
  apk) why="Alpine has no unattended upgrade tool; run apk upgrade from a scheduled task" ;;
  esac
  echo "Not supported with $pm: $why"
  exit 3
done
echo "No supported package manager found"
exit 3

fields.name: Held packages report
fields.description: Lists packages held back from updates (apt-mark hold, dnf versionlock and exclude, zypper locks, pacman IgnorePkg, apk pins).
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Lists packages that are held back from updates (apt-mark hold, dnf versionlock, zypper locks, pacman IgnorePkg, apk pins).
# Variables: none. Exit codes: 0 report printed, 3 no supported package manager.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

if command -v apt-mark >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  out=$(apt-mark showhold 2>/dev/null)
  mgr=apt
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mgr=dnf
  pm=$(command -v dnf || command -v yum)
  out=$("$pm" versionlock list 2>&1)
  case $out in *"nknown command"* | *"No such command"* | *"nrecognized"*)
    echo "Version lock plugin not installed, no locks can exist"
    exit 0
    ;;
  esac
  out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v -e '^Last metadata' -e '^$')
  case $out in *"Error"* | *"error"*) out= ;; esac
  ex=$(grep -hE '^[[:space:]]*exclude[[:space:]]*=' /etc/dnf/dnf.conf /etc/yum.conf 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$ex" ] && out="$out
$ex"
elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mgr=zypper
  out=$(zypper -n locks 2>&1 | grep -E '^[0-9]+ ' )
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mgr=pacman
  out=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(IgnorePkg|IgnoreGroup)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/pacman.conf 2>/dev/null)
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mgr=apk
  out=$(grep -E '[<>=~]' /etc/apk/world 2>/dev/null)
else
  echo "No supported package manager found"
  exit 3
fi
out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed '/^$/d')
if [ -z "$out" ]; then
  echo "No held packages ($mgr)"
else
  echo "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | wc -l) held entry/entries ($mgr)"
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
fi
exit 0

fields.name: Add SSH key
fields.description: Adds a public key to a user's authorized_keys after a format check, without duplicates; the file is written as that user, symlinks are refused.

variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name

variables.help: One key line (ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa, ecdsa); options such as command= are refused.
variables.name: PUBLIC_KEY
variables.label: Public key

fields.name: Create user
fields.description: Creates a local user with optional password, sudo rights, SSH key and shell. An existing user is only completed. Passwords are passed to chpasswd on stdin.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Creates a local user, optionally with password, sudo rights and an SSH key; an existing user is only completed.
# Variables: TARGET_USER (required), PASSWORD (optional), SUDO (default false), SSH_PUBLIC_KEY (optional), LOGIN_SHELL (optional, default /bin/bash or /bin/sh).
# Exit codes: 0 user in place, 1 failed, 3 bad input or unsupported system.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

u=${TARGET_USER:-}
pw=${PASSWORD:-}
sudo_=${SUDO:-false}
key=${SSH_PUBLIC_KEY:-}
shl=${LOGIN_SHELL:-}
[ -n "$u" ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is required"; exit 3; }
case $u in [!a-z_]* | *[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo "TARGET_USER must be lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or _"; exit 3 ;; esac
[ ${#u} -le 32 ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is longer than 32 characters"; exit 3; }
case $sudo_ in true | false) ;; *) echo "SUDO must be true or false"; exit 3 ;; esac
if [ "$sudo_" = true ] && ! command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sudo is not installed: install the sudo package, then run again"
  exit 3
fi
if [ -n "$pw" ]; then
  [ ${#pw} -ge 8 ] && [ ${#pw} -le 128 ] || { echo "PASSWORD must be 8-128 characters"; exit 3; }
  case $pw in *"
"*) echo "PASSWORD must not contain a line break"; exit 3 ;; esac
fi
if [ -n "$key" ]; then
  key=$(printf '%s' "$key" | tr -d '\r' | sed -n '1p')
  echo "$key" | grep -Eq '^(ssh-ed25519|ssh-rsa|ecdsa-sha2-nistp(256|384|521)|sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh\.com|sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh\.com) [A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,}=*( [[:print:]]*)?$' ||
    { echo "SSH_PUBLIC_KEY is not a plain public key line"; exit 3; }
fi
if [ -z "$shl" ]; then
  if [ -x /bin/bash ]; then shl=/bin/bash; else shl=/bin/sh; fi
fi
case $shl in /*) ;; *) echo "LOGIN_SHELL must be an absolute path"; exit 3 ;; esac
case $shl in *[!A-Za-z0-9/_.-]*) echo "LOGIN_SHELL has characters that are not allowed"; exit 3 ;; esac
grep -qx "$shl" /etc/shells 2>/dev/null && [ -x "$shl" ] || { echo "LOGIN_SHELL $shl is not listed in /etc/shells or not installed"; exit 3; }

did=
if getent passwd "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "User $u already exists"
else
  if command -v useradd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    useradd -m -s "$shl" "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "useradd failed"; exit 1; }
  elif command -v adduser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    adduser -D -s "$shl" "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "adduser failed"; exit 1; }
    printf '%s:*\n' "$u" | chpasswd -e >/dev/null 2>&1
  else
    echo "Neither useradd nor adduser found"
    exit 3
  fi
  getent passwd "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "User $u missing after creation"; exit 1; }
  did="created"
fi
home=$(getent passwd "$u" | cut -d: -f6)

if [ -n "$pw" ]; then
  printf '%s:%s\n' "$u" "$pw" | chpasswd >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Setting the password failed"; exit 1; }
  did="${did:+$did, }password set"
fi
if [ "$sudo_" = true ]; then
  command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sudo is not installed: install the sudo package, then run again"; exit 3; }
  g=
  for c in sudo wheel; do getent group "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && g=$c && break; done
  if [ -z "$g" ]; then
    groupadd wheel >/dev/null 2>&1 || addgroup -S wheel >/dev/null 2>&1
    g=wheel
  fi
  if ! id -Gn "$u" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx "$g"; then
    { usermod -aG "$g" "$u" || addgroup "$u" "$g"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Adding $u to $g failed"; exit 1; }
    did="${did:+$did, }added to $g"
  fi
  if ! cat /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/* 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "^%${g}[[:space:]]"; then
    f=/etc/sudoers.d/ulrmm-$g
    mkdir -p /etc/sudoers.d
    printf '%%%s ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL\n' "$g" >"$f.tmp"
    chmod 440 "$f.tmp"
    if command -v visudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! visudo -cf "$f.tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$f.tmp"; echo "sudoers rule invalid"; exit 1; fi
    mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
    did="${did:+$did, }sudoers rule for %$g added"
  fi
  [ -n "$pw" ] || echo "Note: $u has no password, sudo will ask for one"
fi
if [ -n "$key" ]; then
  [ -d "$home" ] && [ ! -L "$home" ] && [ "$home" != / ] || { echo "Home directory $home is not usable for an SSH key"; exit 1; }
  # Written as the user, so a symlink or hard link the user planted cannot redirect a root write.
  # shellcheck disable=SC2016
  KEYLINE=$key KEYHOME=$home su -s /bin/sh "$u" -c '
  umask 077
  cd "$KEYHOME" || exit 4
  f=.ssh/authorized_keys
  if [ -L .ssh ] || [ -L "$f" ] || { [ -e "$f" ] && [ ! -f "$f" ]; }; then exit 5; fi
  mkdir -p .ssh && chmod 700 .ssh || exit 6
  b=$(printf "%s\n" "$KEYLINE" | awk "{print \$2}")
  if [ -f "$f" ] && awk -v b="$b" "\$2==b || \$3==b {f=1} END {exit !f}" "$f"; then chmod 600 "$f"; exit 10; fi
  if [ -s "$f" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c1 "$f")" ]; then printf "\n" >>"$f" || exit 6; fi
  printf "%s\n" "$KEYLINE" >>"$f" && chmod 600 "$f" || exit 6
  ' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  case $rc in
  0) did="${did:+$did, }SSH key added" ;;
  10) echo "SSH key already present" ;;
  4) echo "Home directory $home is not usable"; exit 1 ;;
  5) echo "$home/.ssh or its authorized_keys is a symlink or not a regular file, refusing"; exit 1 ;;
  *) echo "Writing $home/.ssh/authorized_keys as $u failed (exit $rc): check ownership, or the account is expired"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
fi
echo "User $u ready${did:+ ($did)}"
exit 0

fields.name: Delete user
fields.description: Deletes a local user. Refuses root, system accounts, logged-in users and the last sudo member. The home directory is kept unless asked.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Deletes a local user. Refuses root, system accounts, logged-in users and the last admin.
# Variables: TARGET_USER (required), REMOVE_HOME (default false).
# Exit codes: 0 user gone, 1 failed, 3 bad input or a guard refused it.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

u=${TARGET_USER:-}
rm_home=${REMOVE_HOME:-false}
[ -n "$u" ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is required"; exit 3; }
case $u in [!a-z_]* | *[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo "TARGET_USER has characters that are not allowed"; exit 3 ;; esac
case $rm_home in true | false) ;; *) echo "REMOVE_HOME must be true or false"; exit 3 ;; esac
ent=$(getent passwd "$u") || { echo "User $u does not exist, nothing to do"; exit 0; }
uid=$(echo "$ent" | cut -d: -f3)
umin=$(awk '$1=="UID_MIN" {print $2}' /etc/login.defs 2>/dev/null)
umin=${umin:-1000}
[ "$uid" -ne 0 ] && [ "$u" != root ] || { echo "Refusing to delete root"; exit 3; }
[ "$uid" -ge "$umin" ] && [ "$uid" -lt 65534 ] || { echo "Refusing to delete $u: uid $uid is a system account"; exit 3; }
if who 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "$u" || pgrep -u "$uid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Refusing to delete $u: the user is logged in or has running processes"
  exit 3
fi
mine=0
others=0
for g in sudo wheel admin; do
  for m in $(getent group "$g" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f4 | tr ',' ' '); do
    if [ "$m" = "$u" ]; then mine=1; continue; fi
    case $(awk -F: -v u="$m" '$1==u {print $2}' /etc/shadow) in '!'* | '*'* | '') ;; *) others=$((others + 1)) ;; esac
  done
done
case $(awk -F: '$1=="root" {print $2}' /etc/shadow) in '' | '!'* | '*'*) ;; *) others=$((others + 1)) ;; esac
if [ "$mine" = 1 ] && [ "$others" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Refusing to delete $u: it is the last sudo/wheel member"
  exit 3
fi
home=$(echo "$ent" | cut -d: -f6)
if command -v userdel >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$rm_home" = true ]; then userdel -r "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; else userdel "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
elif command -v deluser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$rm_home" = true ]; then deluser --remove-home "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; else deluser "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
else
  echo "Neither userdel nor deluser found"
  exit 3
fi
getent passwd "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "User $u still exists after deletion"; exit 1; }
for c in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/"$u" /var/spool/cron/"$u" /var/spool/cron/tabs/"$u"; do
  [ -f "$c" ] && echo "Note: crontab $c of $u still exists"
done
if [ "$rm_home" = true ]; then
  [ -d "$home" ] && echo "Deleted $u, home $home was kept (not removed by the tool)" || echo "Deleted $u and removed $home"
else
  echo "Deleted $u, home directory $home kept"
fi
exit 0

fields.name: Lock or unlock user
fields.description: Locks the password and expires the account (so key logins stop), or reverses it. Refuses root and the last unlocked admin.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Locks or unlocks a local account (password lock plus account expiry, so key logins stop too).
# Variables: TARGET_USER (required), STATE (lock, unlock; default lock).
# Exit codes: 0 in requested state, 1 failed, 3 bad input, unknown user or a guard refused it.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

u=${TARGET_USER:-}
st=${STATE:-lock}
[ -n "$u" ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is required"; exit 3; }
case $u in [!a-z_]* | *[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo "TARGET_USER has characters that are not allowed"; exit 3 ;; esac
case $st in lock | unlock) ;; *) echo "STATE must be lock or unlock"; exit 3 ;; esac
ent=$(getent passwd "$u") || { echo "User $u does not exist"; exit 3; }
uid=$(echo "$ent" | cut -d: -f3)
fld() { awk -F: -v u="$u" -v n="$1" '$1==u {print $n}' /etc/shadow; }
locked() { case $(fld 2) in '!'*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
expired() { case $(fld 8) in 0 | 1) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }

if [ "$st" = lock ]; then
  [ "$uid" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Refusing to lock root"; exit 3; }
  others=0
  for g in sudo wheel admin; do
    for m in $(getent group "$g" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f4 | tr ',' ' '); do
      [ "$m" = "$u" ] && continue
      case $(awk -F: -v u="$m" '$1==u {print $2}' /etc/shadow) in '!'* | '*'* | '') ;; *) others=$((others + 1)) ;; esac
    done
  done
  case $(awk -F: '$1=="root" {print $2}' /etc/shadow) in '' | '!'* | '*'*) ;; *) others=$((others + 1)) ;; esac
  mine=0
  for g in sudo wheel admin; do getent group "$g" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f4 | tr ',' '\n' | grep -qx "$u" && mine=1; done
  if [ "$mine" = 1 ] && [ "$others" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Refusing to lock $u: it is the last unlocked admin account"
    exit 3
  fi
  if locked && { expired || ! command -v usermod >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then echo "User $u already locked"; exit 0; fi
  if ! locked; then
    { usermod -L "$u" || passwd -l "$u"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Locking the password failed"; exit 1; }
  fi
  if command -v usermod >/dev/null 2>&1; then usermod -e 1 "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ex=" and expired"; else ex=" (password only, no usermod to expire the account)"; fi
  locked || { echo "User $u is not locked after the change"; exit 1; }
  echo "User $u locked${ex:-}"
  exit 0
fi
done=
nohash=
case $(fld 2) in '!' | '!!' | '!*' | '!!*') nohash=1 ;; esac
if locked && [ -z "$nohash" ]; then
  { usermod -U "$u" || passwd -u "$u"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Unlocking failed"; exit 1; }
  done=1
fi
if expired && command -v usermod >/dev/null 2>&1; then usermod -e "" "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && done=1; fi
[ -z "$nohash" ] && locked && { echo "User $u still locked"; exit 1; }
[ -n "$nohash" ] && echo "Note: $u has no password (key login only), set one with the set password script"
if [ -n "$done" ]; then echo "User $u unlocked"; else echo "User $u already unlocked"; fi
case $(fld 2) in '') echo "Note: $u has an empty password" ;; esac
exit 0

fields.name: SSH keys audit
fields.description: Lists every authorized SSH key per account with size and fingerprint. Exit 2 when DSA or short RSA keys exist, 3 without ssh-keygen.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Lists the authorized SSH keys of every account with fingerprint and size; flags weak keys.
# Variables: none. Exit codes: 0 done, 2 weak keys (DSA or RSA below 2048 bits) found, 3 ssh-keygen missing.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

command -v ssh-keygen >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ssh-keygen not found: install openssh-client (openssh-clients, openssh)"; exit 3; }
tmp=$(mktemp) || exit 3
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
total=0
weak=0
awk -F: '$6!="" && $6!="/" {print $1":"$6}' /etc/passwd | while IFS=: read -r u home; do
  f=$home/.ssh/authorized_keys
  [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ] || continue
  ssh-keygen -l -f "$f" 2>/dev/null | while read -r bits fp rest; do
    printf '%s %s %s %s\n' "$u" "$bits" "$fp" "$rest"
  done
done >"$tmp"
total=$(wc -l <"$tmp")
weak=$(awk '($2<2048 && $NF!="(ED25519)" && $NF!="(ECDSA)" && $NF!="(ECDSA-SK)" && $NF!="(ED25519-SK)") || $NF=="(DSA)" {c++} END {print c+0}' "$tmp")
if [ "$weak" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$total key(s), $weak weak"; else echo "$total key(s), none weak"; fi
cat "$tmp"
[ "$weak" -eq 0 ] || exit 2
exit 0

fields.name: Users list
fields.description: Lists login-capable accounts with groups, locked state, last login and number of SSH keys.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Lists login-capable accounts with groups, locked state, last login and number of SSH keys.
# Variables: none. Exit codes: 0 done, 3 /etc/passwd unreadable.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }

[ -r /etc/passwd ] || { echo "/etc/passwd not readable"; exit 3; }
umin=$(awk '$1=="UID_MIN" {print $2}' /etc/login.defs 2>/dev/null)
umin=${umin:-1000}
case $umin in *[!0-9]*) umin=1000 ;; esac
tmp=$(mktemp) || exit 3
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
awk -F: -v m="$umin" '($3==0 || $3>=m) && $3<65534 && $7!~/(nologin|false|sync|shutdown|halt)$/ && $7!="" {print $1":"$3":"$6}' /etc/passwd >"$tmp"
echo "$(wc -l <"$tmp") login-capable account(s)"
printf '%-16s %-6s %-22s %-7s %-4s %s\n' USER UID GROUPS STATE KEYS LAST
while IFS=: read -r u uid home; do
  groups=$(id -Gn "$u" 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' ',' | cut -c1-22)
  pw=$(awk -F: -v u="$u" '$1==u {print $2}' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null)
  case $pw in '!'* | '*'*) state=locked ;; '') state=nopass ;; *) state=active ;; esac
  keys=0
  f=$home/.ssh/authorized_keys
  [ -f "$f" ] && keys=$(grep -Ecv '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$f")
  last=never
  if command -v lastlog >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    l=$(lastlog -u "$u" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '2p')
    case $l in *"Never logged in"*) ;; '') last=n/a ;; *) last=$(printf '%s' "$l" | awk '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /^[0-9]{4}$/) {printf "%s %s %s %s", $(i-4), $(i-3), $(i-2), $i; exit}}') ;; esac
  elif command -v last >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    l=$(last -n 1 "$u" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p')
    case $l in '' | wtmp* | *"begins"*) ;; *) last=$(printf '%s' "$l" | awk '{print $4,$5,$6,$7}') ;; esac
  else
    last=n/a
  fi
  printf '%-16s %-6s %-22s %-7s %-4s %s\n' "$u" "$uid" "$groups" "$state" "$keys" "${last:-n/a}"
done <"$tmp"
exit 0

fields.name: System report
fields.description: Prints model, serial, BIOS, OS build, install date, uptime, CPU, RAM, disks and network adapters with their IP addresses.
fields.script_body:
# Prints a hardware and operating system summary: model, serial, BIOS, OS build, install date, uptime, CPU, RAM, disks and network adapters.
# Variables: none
# Exit: 0 reported, 3 CIM data unavailable
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
try {
    $cs = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem
    $bios = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_BIOS
    $os = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem
    $cpu = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Processor)
    $disks = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3')
    $nics = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration -Filter 'IPEnabled=True')
} catch {
    Write-Output ('Cannot read system information: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    exit 3
}
$build = $os.Version
$ubr = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UBR
if ($null -ne $ubr) { $build = $build + '.' + $ubr }
$up = (Get-Date) - $os.LastBootUpTime
Write-Output ('Host: ' + $env:COMPUTERNAME + ' (' + $cs.Domain + ')')
Write-Output ('Model: ' + $cs.Manufacturer + ' ' + $cs.Model)
Write-Output ('Serial: ' + $bios.SerialNumber)
Write-Output ('BIOS: ' + $bios.Manufacturer + ' ' + $bios.SMBIOSBIOSVersion + ' (' + ('{0:yyyy-MM-dd}' -f $bios.ReleaseDate) + ')')
Write-Output ('OS: ' + $os.Caption + ' ' + $os.OSArchitecture + ', build ' + $build)
Write-Output ('Installed: {0:yyyy-MM-dd}' -f $os.InstallDate)
Write-Output ('Uptime: {0}d {1}h {2}m' -f $up.Days, $up.Hours, $up.Minutes)
foreach ($c in $cpu) {
    Write-Output ('CPU: ' + ($c.Name -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim() + ', ' + $c.NumberOfCores + ' cores, ' + $c.NumberOfLogicalProcessors + ' threads')
}
Write-Output ('RAM: {0:N1} GB' -f ($cs.TotalPhysicalMemory / 1GB))
foreach ($d in $disks) {
    Write-Output ('Disk {0} {1:N1} GB free of {2:N1} GB ({3})' -f $d.DeviceID, ($d.FreeSpace / 1GB), ($d.Size / 1GB), $d.FileSystem)
}
foreach ($n in $nics) {
    Write-Output ('NIC: ' + $n.Description + ' | MAC ' + $n.MACAddress + ' | ' + (@($n.IPAddress) -join ', '))
}
exit 0

fields.name: End process
fields.description: Ends every process with the given name. Core Windows processes and the RMM agents are protected. Exit 0 also when nothing was running.
fields.script_body:
# Ends every process with the given name.
# Variables: NAME process name, with or without .exe.
# Exit: 0 ended or not running, 1 a process could not be ended, 3 bad input or protected process.
$name = ''
if ($env:NAME) { $name = $env:NAME.Trim() -replace '\.exe$', '' }
if ($name -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_. -]{1,64}$') { Write-Output 'NAME is required: letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore only'; exit 3 }
$protected = 'system', 'idle', 'registry', 'smss', 'csrss', 'wininit', 'winlogon', 'services', 'lsass', 'lsaiso', 'fontdrvhost', 'svchost', 'dwm','ulrmm-agent', 'meshagent', 'rustdesk'
if ($protected -contains $name.ToLower()) { Write-Output "'$name' is protected and not ended"; exit 3 }

$procs = @(Get-Process -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne $PID })
if ($procs.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output "No process named '$name' is running"; exit 0 }
$ids = @($procs | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
$procs | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$left = @(Get-Process -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $ids -contains $_.Id })
Write-Output ("Ended {0} of {1} process(es) named '{2}'" -f ($ids.Count - $left.Count), $ids.Count, $name)
if ($left.Count -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0

fields.script_body:
# Reports the time since the last boot and warns when it is longer than the limit.
# Variables: MAX_DAYS (30) uptime limit in days.
# Exit: 0 within the limit, 2 above the limit, 3 bad input.
$max = 30
if ($env:MAX_DAYS) { if (-not [int]::TryParse($env:MAX_DAYS.Trim(), [ref]$max) -or $max -lt 1 -or $max -gt 3650) { Write-Output 'MAX_DAYS must be a number from 1 to 3650'; exit 3 } }
$boot = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
$up = (Get-Date) - $boot
$text = '{0} days {1} h {2} min (since {3:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm})' -f $up.Days, $up.Hours, $up.Minutes, $boot
if ($up.TotalDays -gt $max) { Write-Output "WARNING: uptime $text, limit $max days"; exit 2 }
Write-Output "OK: uptime $text"
exit 0

variables.help: Warn above this.
variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Maximum uptime (days)

fields.name: Agent services status
fields.description: State of the agent launch daemon, its self-healing job and the MeshCentral agent, with the file paths. Exit 1 when the agent is not running, 2 when the other two are not up.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Status of the agent launch daemon (ulrmm-agent), its self-healing job and the MeshCentral agent. No variables.
# Exit: 0 all running, 1 agent not running, 2 self-healing job or mesh agent missing or not running, 3 not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

# prints "running pid N", "loaded (not running)" or "not loaded"
svc() {
  local out pid
  out=$(launchctl print "system/$1" 2>/dev/null) || { echo "not loaded"; return; }
  pid=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*pid = \([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo "running pid $pid"; else echo "loaded (not running)"; fi
}
file() { if [ -e "$2" ]; then echo "  $1: $2"; else echo "  $1: $2 MISSING"; fi; }

rc=0
a=$(svc ulrmm-agent)
h=$(svc ulrmm-agent.selfheal)
m=$(svc meshagent)
case "$a" in running*) ;; *) rc=1 ;; esac
# the self-healing job runs on an interval, so loaded between runs is normal
[ "$h" = "not loaded" ] && [ $rc -eq 0 ] && rc=2
case "$m" in running*) ;; *) [ $rc -eq 0 ] && rc=2 ;; esac

case $rc in
0) echo "OK: agent, self-healing job and mesh agent are up" ;;
1) echo "FAILING: the agent service is not running" ;;
*) echo "WARNING: self-healing job or mesh agent is not up" ;;
esac
echo "Agent service ulrmm-agent: $a"
file plist /Library/LaunchDaemons/ulrmm-agent.plist
file binary /opt/ulrmm-agent/ulrmm-agent
file log /var/log/ulrmm-agent.log
echo "Self-healing job ulrmm-agent.selfheal: $h"
file plist /Library/LaunchDaemons/ulrmm-agent.selfheal.plist
echo "MeshCentral agent meshagent: $m"
if [ -x /opt/ulrmm-mesh/meshagent ]; then
  echo "  binary: /opt/ulrmm-mesh/meshagent"
elif [ -x /usr/local/mesh_services/meshagent/meshagent ]; then
  echo "  binary: /usr/local/mesh_services/meshagent/meshagent"
else
  echo "  binary: not found under /opt/ulrmm-mesh or /usr/local/mesh_services"
fi
exit $rc

fields.name: Avast Security - install
fields.description: Installs Avast Security from Avast's online disk image after the Team ID check. System extension and Full Disk Access need the user or MDM.
fields.syntax: Checks pkgutil signature, Team ID and Gatekeeper before installer runs.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs a macOS antivirus package after checking its Developer ID Installer Team ID and Gatekeeper assessment.
# Variables: PRODUCT (required) defender, malwarebytes, avast, avg, eset-endpoint, clamav;
#   INSTALLER_URL ("" = vendor default, https only); ALLOW_EXISTING (false).
# Exit: 0 installed or already installed, 1 failed, 3 bad input, unsupported system or another antivirus present.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

result() {
	echo "RESULT: $2"
	exit "$1"
}

product=$(printf '%s' "${PRODUCT:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
url_override=${INSTALLER_URL:-}
allow_existing=${ALLOW_EXISTING:-false}

# team: Apple Team ID of the installer signature, receipt: pkgutil id that proves the install,
# own: system extension prefix of the product itself.
case "$product" in
defender)
	name="Microsoft Defender for Endpoint"; team=UBF8T346G9; own='com\.microsoft\.wdav'
	url='https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2097502'; receipt='^com\.microsoft\.wdav$'
	approve="onboarding profile WindowsDefenderATPOnboarding.mobileconfig, system extensions com.microsoft.wdav.epsext and .netext, Full Disk Access" ;;
malwarebytes)
	name="Malwarebytes for Mac"; team=GVZRY6KDKR; own='com\.malwarebytes'
	url='https://downloads.malwarebytes.com/file/mb-mac'; receipt='^com\.malwarebytes\.mbam\.installer$'
	approve="Full Disk Access for the real-time protection daemon, system extension for web protection" ;;
avast)
	name="Avast Security"; team=6H4HRTU5E3; own='com\.avast'
	url='https://www.avast.com/en-us/download-thank-you.php?product=MAC-FREE-ONLINE&direct=1'; receipt='^com\.avast\.avast$'
	approve="system extension com.avast.Antivirus.SystemExtension, Full Disk Access, content filter" ;;
avg)
	name="AVG AntiVirus"; team=XSJ59WMJBM; own='com\.avg'
	url='https://bits.avcdn.net/productfamily_ANTIVIRUS/insttype_FREE/platform_MAC_AVG/installertype_ONLINE/build_RELEASE'
	receipt='^com\.avg\.avg$'; approve="system extension and Full Disk Access" ;;
eset-endpoint)
	name="ESET Endpoint Security"; team=P8DQRXPVLP; own='com\.eset'
	url='https://download.eset.com/com/eset/apps/business/ees/mac/g2/latest/ees_osx.dmg'; receipt='^com\.eset\.'
	approve="system extensions com.eset.endpoint, com.eset.network, com.eset.firewall, Full Disk Access, license in the product or ESET PROTECT" ;;
clamav)
	name="ClamAV"; team=DE8Y96K9QP; own='-'; url=''; receipt='^com\.cisco\.ClamAV\.programs$'
	approve="Full Disk Access for the process that runs clamscan, otherwise protected folders are skipped" ;;
*) result 3 "failed PRODUCT must be one of: defender, malwarebytes, avast, avg, eset-endpoint, clamav" ;;
esac
case "$allow_existing" in true | false) ;; *) result 3 "failed ALLOW_EXISTING must be true or false" ;; esac
if [ -n "$url_override" ]; then
	case "$url_override" in
	https://*) ;;
	*) result 3 "failed INSTALLER_URL must start with https://" ;;
	esac
	case "$url_override" in *[[:space:]\"\'\`]*) result 3 "failed INSTALLER_URL contains spaces or quotes" ;; esac
	url=$url_override
fi

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || result 3 "failed must run as root"
major=$(sw_vers -productVersion | cut -d. -f1)
[ "$major" -ge 13 ] 2>/dev/null || result 3 "failed macOS 13 or later is required"

have=$(pkgutil --pkgs | grep -E "$receipt" | head -n 1)
if [ -n "$have" ]; then
	v=$(pkgutil --pkg-info "$have" | sed -n 's/^version: //p')
	echo "Already installed: $have $v"
	result 0 "installed $name $v"
fi

if [ "$product" != clamav ]; then
	others=$(systemextensionsctl list 2>/dev/null | grep 'activated enabled' |
		grep -iE 'com\.(eset|bitdefender|kaspersky|avast|avg|malwarebytes|sophos|symantec|norton|microsoft\.wdav|intego|mcafee|trendmicro|f-secure|withsecure)' |
		grep -viE "$own" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i ~ /^com\./) { print $i; break } }' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
	if [ -n "$others" ]; then
		[ "$allow_existing" = true ] || result 3 "failed another antivirus is active: $others- remove it first or set ALLOW_EXISTING"
		echo "Continuing although another antivirus is active: $others"
	fi
fi

work=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/ulrmm-av.XXXXXX) || result 1 "failed cannot create a working directory"
mnt="$work/mnt"
trap '[ -d "$mnt" ] && hdiutil detach -quiet -force "$mnt" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

if [ -z "$url" ]; then
	url=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 60 https://api.github.com/repos/Cisco-Talos/clamav/releases/latest |
		sed -n 's/.*"browser_download_url": *"\(https:[^"]*macos\.universal\.pkg\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
	[ -n "$url" ] || result 1 "failed cannot find the latest ClamAV macOS package on GitHub"
fi

echo "Downloading $name from $(echo "$url" | cut -d/ -f3)"
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 3600 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -o "$work/download" "$url" ||
	result 1 "failed download"

pkg="$work/download"
if [ "$(head -c 4 "$work/download")" != "xar!" ]; then
	mkdir "$mnt"
	# Disk images with a license agreement wait for an answer on stdin.
	yes | hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -noautoopen -mountpoint "$mnt" "$work/download" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
		result 1 "failed the download is neither a package nor a disk image"
	pkg=$(find "$mnt" -maxdepth 3 -name '*.pkg' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
	[ -n "$pkg" ] || result 1 "failed no installer package in the disk image"
fi

sig=$(pkgutil --check-signature "$pkg" 2>&1)
signer=$(echo "$sig" | sed -n 's/^ *1\. //p' | head -n 1)
case "$sig" in
*"signed by a developer certificate issued by Apple for distribution"*) ;;
*) result 1 "failed package is not signed with a Developer ID certificate, not installed" ;;
esac
case "$signer" in
"Developer ID Installer: "*"($team)") ;;
*) result 1 "failed signed by '$signer', expected Team ID $team, not installed" ;;
esac
spctl --assess --type install "$pkg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || result 1 "failed Gatekeeper rejects the package, not installed"
echo "Signature valid: $signer"

out=$(installer -pkg "$pkg" -target / 2>&1)
irc=$?
echo "$out" | tail -n 3
[ $irc -eq 0 ] || result 1 "failed installer exit code $irc"

have=$(pkgutil --pkgs | grep -E "$receipt" | head -n 1)
[ -n "$have" ] || result 1 "failed installer finished but no receipt matches $receipt"
v=$(pkgutil --pkg-info "$have" | sed -n 's/^version: //p')

if [ "$product" = clamav ]; then
	conf=/usr/local/clamav/etc/freshclam.conf
	if [ ! -f "$conf" ] && [ -f "$conf.sample" ]; then
		sed 's/^Example/#Example/' "$conf.sample" >"$conf" && echo "Created $conf; run freshclam once before the first scan"
	fi
fi
echo "Needs approval by the user or an MDM profile (root cannot grant it): $approve"
if [ "$product" != clamav ]; then
	state=$(systemextensionsctl list 2>/dev/null | grep "$team" | awk -F'\t' '{ print $4, $NF }')
	[ -n "$state" ] && echo "System extensions now: $state"
fi
result 0 "installed $name $v"

fields.name: Built-in protection status
fields.description: Checks Gatekeeper, System Integrity Protection and the XProtect age and lists active antivirus system extensions.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Checks the built-in macOS malware protection: Gatekeeper, System Integrity Protection and XProtect age;
#   lists active antivirus system extensions.
# Variables: WARN_DAYS (45) XProtect older than this many days is a warning.
# Exit: 0 ok, 1 Gatekeeper or SIP off or XProtect missing, 2 XProtect old, 3 bad input or unsupported system.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

warn_days=${WARN_DAYS:-45}
case "$warn_days" in
'' | *[!0-9]*) echo "WARN_DAYS must be a whole number"; exit 3 ;;
esac
major=$(sw_vers -productVersion | cut -d. -f1)
[ "$major" -ge 13 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "macOS 13 or later is required"; exit 3; }

gk=$(spctl --status 2>&1)
sip=$(csrutil status 2>&1)

# macOS 15 and later keep the active XProtect bundle under /var/protected.
xp_version=""
xp_mtime=0
for b in /private/var/protected/xprotect/XProtect.bundle /Library/Apple/System/Library/CoreServices/XProtect.bundle; do
	plist="$b/Contents/Info.plist"
	[ -f "$plist" ] || continue
	t=$(stat -f %m "$plist" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
	if [ "$t" -gt "$xp_mtime" ]; then
		xp_mtime=$t
		xp_version=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleShortVersionString' "$plist" 2>/dev/null)
	fi
done
if command -v xprotect >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	v=$(xprotect version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
	[ -n "$v" ] && xp_version=$v
fi

rc=0
verdict=""
case "$gk" in
*"assessments enabled"*) ;;
*) rc=1; verdict="Gatekeeper is off" ;;
esac
case "$sip" in
*"status: enabled"*) ;;
*) rc=1; verdict="${verdict:+$verdict, }SIP is not fully enabled" ;;
esac
age=-1
if [ "$xp_mtime" -eq 0 ]; then
	rc=1
	verdict="${verdict:+$verdict, }XProtect not found"
else
	age=$((($(date +%s) - xp_mtime) / 86400))
	if [ "$age" -gt "$warn_days" ] && [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
		rc=2
		verdict="XProtect is $age days old"
	fi
fi

case $rc in
0) echo "OK: Gatekeeper on, SIP on, XProtect $xp_version ($age days old)" ;;
1) echo "FAIL: $verdict" ;;
2) echo "WARNING: $verdict" ;;
esac
echo "Gatekeeper: $gk"
echo "$sip" | head -n 1
echo "XProtect: ${xp_version:-unknown}, updated $([ "$xp_mtime" -gt 0 ] && date -r "$xp_mtime" '+%Y-%m-%d')"
ext=$(systemextensionsctl list 2>/dev/null | grep 'activated enabled' | grep -iE 'eset|bitdefender|kaspersky|avast|avg|malwarebytes|sophos|symantec|norton|wdav|intego|mcafee|trendmicro|f-secure|withsecure')
if [ -n "$ext" ]; then
	echo "Antivirus system extensions:"
	echo "$ext" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i ~ /\./ && $i !~ /^[0-9.()]+$/) { print "  " $i; break } }'
else
	echo "Antivirus system extensions: none active"
fi
exit $rc

variables.help: XProtect data older than this is a warning.
variables.name: WARN_DAYS
variables.label: Warn at XProtect age (days)

	approve="onboarding profile WindowsDefenderATPOnboarding.mobileconfig, system extensions com.microsoft.wdav.epsext and .netext, Full Disk Access" ;;
malwarebytes)
	name="Malwarebytes for Mac"; team=GVZRY6KDKR; own='com\.malwarebytes'
	url='https://downloads.malwarebytes.com/file/mb-mac'; receipt='^com\.malwarebytes\.mbam\.installer$'
	approve="Full Disk Access for the real-time protection daemon, system extension for web protection" ;;
avast)
	name="Avast Security"; team=6H4HRTU5E3; own='com\.avast'
	url='https://www.avast.com/en-us/download-thank-you.php?product=MAC-FREE-ONLINE&direct=1'; receipt='^com\.avast\.avast$'
	approve="system extension com.avast.Antivirus.SystemExtension, Full Disk Access, content filter" ;;
avg)
	name="AVG AntiVirus"; team=XSJ59WMJBM; own='com\.avg'
	url='https://bits.avcdn.net/productfamily_ANTIVIRUS/insttype_FREE/platform_MAC_AVG/installertype_ONLINE/build_RELEASE'
	receipt='^com\.avg\.avg$'; approve="system extension and Full Disk Access" ;;
eset-endpoint)
	name="ESET Endpoint Security"; team=P8DQRXPVLP; own='com\.eset'
	url='https://download.eset.com/com/eset/apps/business/ees/mac/g2/latest/ees_osx.dmg'; receipt='^com\.eset\.'
	approve="system extensions com.eset.endpoint, com.eset.network, com.eset.firewall, Full Disk Access, license in the product or ESET PROTECT" ;;
clamav)
	name="ClamAV"; team=DE8Y96K9QP; own='-'; url=''; receipt='^com\.cisco\.ClamAV\.programs$'
	approve="Full Disk Access for the process that runs clamscan, otherwise protected folders are skipped" ;;
*) result 3 "failed PRODUCT must be one of: defender, malwarebytes, avast, avg, eset-endpoint, clamav" ;;
esac
case "$allow_existing" in true | false) ;; *) result 3 "failed ALLOW_EXISTING must be true or false" ;; esac
if [ -n "$url_override" ]; then
	case "$url_override" in
	https://*) ;;
	*) result 3 "failed INSTALLER_URL must start with https://" ;;
	esac
	case "$url_override" in *[[:space:]\"\'\`]*) result 3 "failed INSTALLER_URL contains spaces or quotes" ;; esac
	url=$url_override
fi

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || result 3 "failed must run as root"
major=$(sw_vers -productVersion | cut -d. -f1)
[ "$major" -ge 13 ] 2>/dev/null || result 3 "failed macOS 13 or later is required"

have=$(pkgutil --pkgs | grep -E "$receipt" | head -n 1)
if [ -n "$have" ]; then
	v=$(pkgutil --pkg-info "$have" | sed -n 's/^version: //p')
	echo "Already installed: $have $v"
	result 0 "installed $name $v"
fi

if [ "$product" != clamav ]; then
	others=$(systemextensionsctl list 2>/dev/null | grep 'activated enabled' |
		grep -iE 'com\.(eset|bitdefender|kaspersky|avast|avg|malwarebytes|sophos|symantec|norton|microsoft\.wdav|intego|mcafee|trendmicro|f-secure|withsecure)' |
		grep -viE "$own" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i ~ /^com\./) { print $i; break } }' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
	if [ -n "$others" ]; then
		[ "$allow_existing" = true ] || result 3 "failed another antivirus is active: $others- remove it first or set ALLOW_EXISTING"
		echo "Continuing although another antivirus is active: $others"
	fi
fi

work=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/ulrmm-av.XXXXXX) || result 1 "failed cannot create a working directory"
mnt="$work/mnt"
trap '[ -d "$mnt" ] && hdiutil detach -quiet -force "$mnt" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

if [ -z "$url" ]; then
	url=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 60 https://api.github.com/repos/Cisco-Talos/clamav/releases/latest |
		sed -n 's/.*"browser_download_url": *"\(https:[^"]*macos\.universal\.pkg\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
	[ -n "$url" ] || result 1 "failed cannot find the latest ClamAV macOS package on GitHub"
fi

echo "Downloading $name from $(echo "$url" | cut -d/ -f3)"
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 3600 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -o "$work/download" "$url" ||
	result 1 "failed download"

pkg="$work/download"
if [ "$(head -c 4 "$work/download")" != "xar!" ]; then
	mkdir "$mnt"
	# Disk images with a license agreement wait for an answer on stdin.
	yes | hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -noautoopen -mountpoint "$mnt" "$work/download" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
		result 1 "failed the download is neither a package nor a disk image"
	pkg=$(find "$mnt" -maxdepth 3 -name '*.pkg' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
	[ -n "$pkg" ] || result 1 "failed no installer package in the disk image"
fi

sig=$(pkgutil --check-signature "$pkg" 2>&1)
signer=$(echo "$sig" | sed -n 's/^ *1\. //p' | head -n 1)
case "$sig" in
*"signed by a developer certificate issued by Apple for distribution"*) ;;
*) result 1 "failed package is not signed with a Developer ID certificate, not installed" ;;
esac
case "$signer" in
"Developer ID Installer: "*"($team)") ;;
*) result 1 "failed signed by '$signer', expected Team ID $team, not installed" ;;
esac
spctl --assess --type install "$pkg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || result 1 "failed Gatekeeper rejects the package, not installed"
echo "Signature valid: $signer"

out=$(installer -pkg "$pkg" -target / 2>&1)
irc=$?
echo "$out" | tail -n 3
[ $irc -eq 0 ] || result 1 "failed installer exit code $irc"

have=$(pkgutil --pkgs | grep -E "$receipt" | head -n 1)
[ -n "$have" ] || result 1 "failed installer finished but no receipt matches $receipt"
v=$(pkgutil --pkg-info "$have" | sed -n 's/^version: //p')

if [ "$product" = clamav ]; then
	conf=/usr/local/clamav/etc/freshclam.conf
	if [ ! -f "$conf" ] && [ -f "$conf.sample" ]; then
		sed 's/^Example/#Example/' "$conf.sample" >"$conf" && echo "Created $conf; run freshclam once before the first scan"
	fi
fi
echo "Needs approval by the user or an MDM profile (root cannot grant it): $approve"
if [ "$product" != clamav ]; then
	state=$(systemextensionsctl list 2>/dev/null | grep "$team" | awk -F'\t' '{ print $4, $NF }')
	[ -n "$state" ] && echo "System extensions now: $state"
fi
result 0 "installed $name $v"

fields.name: System report
fields.description: Model, chip, serial, macOS version and build, uptime, memory, storage, IPv4 addresses, battery cycle count and MDM enrollment state.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# System report: hardware, macOS, memory, storage, addresses, battery, MDM state. No variables.
# Exit: 0 printed, 3 not macOS.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || { echo "Not macOS."; exit 3; }

hw=$(system_profiler SPHardwareDataType 2>/dev/null)
field() { echo "$hw" | sed -n "s/^ *$1: //p" | head -n 1; }

echo "Hostname: $(scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null || hostname)"
echo "Model: $(field 'Model Name') ($(sysctl -n hw.model 2>/dev/null))"
chip=$(field 'Chip')
[ -n "$chip" ] || chip=$(field 'Processor Name')
echo "Chip: $chip"
echo "Serial: $(field 'Serial Number (system)')"
echo "macOS: $(sw_vers -productVersion) ($(sw_vers -buildVersion)), $(uname -m)"
boot=$(sysctl -n kern.boottime 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^{ sec = \([0-9]*\),.*/\1/p')
[ -n "$boot" ] && echo "Uptime: $((($(date +%s) - boot) / 86400)) days, booted $(date -r "$boot" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"
echo "Memory: $(field 'Memory')"
echo "Storage: $(df -h /System/Volumes/Data 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2 {print $2 " total, " $4 " free"}')"
echo "Addresses:"
ifconfig 2>/dev/null | awk '/^[a-z0-9]+:/ {sub(":", "", $1); i = $1} /^\tinet / && i != "lo0" {print "  " i " " $2}'
cycles=$(system_profiler SPPowerDataType 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^ *Cycle Count: //p' | head -n 1)
[ -n "$cycles" ] && echo "Battery cycle count: $cycles"
mdm=$(profiles status -type enrollment 2>&1 | tr '\n' ';' | sed 's/;$//; s/; */; /g')
echo "MDM enrollment: ${mdm:-unknown}"
exit 0

fields.name: Caches and logs clean
fields.description: Removes old files from system and user caches, /Library/Logs and rotated logs in /var/log. Skips com.apple.* caches and app containers. Dry run by default.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Clean old caches and logs. DRY_RUN (true): only count. MAX_AGE_DAYS (30): files not modified for this long.
# Covers /Library/Caches, /Library/Logs, rotated archives in /var/log and the Caches and Logs folders of
# local users. Apple caches (com.apple.*) and app containers are never touched.
# Exit: 0 done or counted, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

dry=${DRY_RUN:-true}
days=${MAX_AGE_DAYS:-30}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
case "$dry" in true | false) ;; *) echo "DRY_RUN must be true or false."; exit 3 ;; esac
case "$days" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "MAX_AGE_DAYS must be a whole number."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$days" -ge 1 ] && [ "$days" -le 3650 ] || { echo "MAX_AGE_DAYS must be 1-3650."; exit 3; }

total_files=0
total_bytes=0

# A user's folders are walked as that user, so a path swapped under the walk gains nothing.
owner=''
as_owner() {
  if [ -n "$owner" ]; then sudo -n -u "#$owner" "$@"; else "$@"; fi
}

# $1 root, remaining args: extra find tests
clean() {
  local root=$1 n b
  shift
  [ -d "$root" ] && [ ! -L "$root" ] || return 0
  set -- "$root" -xdev -type f -mtime "+$days" ! -path '*/com.apple.*' ! -path '*/Containers/*' "$@"
  b=$(as_owner find "$@" -exec stat -f '%z' {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{ n++; s += $1 } END { printf "%d %d", n, s }')
  n=${b% *}
  b=${b#* }
  [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || return 0
  total_files=$((total_files + n))
  total_bytes=$((total_bytes + b))
  printf '%s: %s files, %s KB\n' "$root" "$n" "$((b / 1024))"
  [ "$dry" = true ] || as_owner find "$@" -delete 2>/dev/null
  return 0
}

clean /Library/Caches
clean /Library/Logs
clean /var/log \( -name '*.gz' -o -name '*.bz2' -o -name '*.[0-9]' \)
for home in /Users/*; do
  [ -d "$home" ] && [ ! -L "$home" ] && [ ! -L "$home/Library" ] || continue
  owner=$(stat -f '%u' "$home" 2>/dev/null) || continue
  case "$owner" in '' | 0 | *[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
  clean "$home/Library/Caches"
  clean "$home/Library/Logs"
done
owner=''

mode="Removed"
[ "$dry" = true ] && mode="Would remove (dry run)"
echo "$mode $total_files files, $((total_bytes / 1048576)) MB older than $days days."
echo "Folders protected by privacy rules may be skipped when the agent lacks Full Disk Access."
exit 0

variables.help: Only count what would be removed.
variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run

variables.help: Only files not modified for this long.
variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.label: Older than (days)

fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Flush the DNS cache. No variables.
# Exit: 0 flushed, 1 failed, 3 not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

rc=0
dscacheutil -flushcache || rc=1
killall -HUP mDNSResponder || rc=1
if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "DNS cache flushed."; else echo "Flushing the DNS cache failed."; fi

fields.name: Restart or shut down
fields.description: Schedules a restart or shutdown with shutdown(8), shows the message to the console user and can cancel a pending one. A pending shutdown is replaced.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Restart or shut down. MODE: restart (default), shutdown, cancel. DELAY_MINUTES (1): 0-1440. MESSAGE: shown to the console user.
# Exit: 0 scheduled or cancelled, 1 shutdown could not be scheduled, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

mode=${MODE:-restart}
delay=${DELAY_MINUTES:-1}
msg=${MESSAGE:-}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
case "$mode" in restart | shutdown | cancel) ;; *) echo "MODE must be restart, shutdown or cancel."; exit 3 ;; esac
case "$delay" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "DELAY_MINUTES must be a whole number."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$delay" -le 1440 ] || { echo "DELAY_MINUTES must be 0-1440."; exit 3; }
[ ${#msg} -le 200 ] || { echo "MESSAGE is longer than 200 characters."; exit 3; }
case "$msg" in *[[:cntrl:]]*) echo "MESSAGE must not contain control characters or line breaks."; exit 3 ;; esac

if [ "$mode" = cancel ]; then
  if pgrep -x shutdown >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkill -x shutdown
    echo "Pending shutdown cancelled."
  else
    echo "No shutdown was pending."
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# a pending one is replaced
if pgrep -x shutdown >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pkill -x shutdown
  echo "Replaced a pending shutdown."
fi

if [ "$mode" = restart ]; then
  flag=-r
  what=restart
else
  flag=-h
  what="shut down"
fi
[ -n "$msg" ] || msg="This computer will $what in $delay minute(s)."

when="+$delay"
[ "$delay" -eq 0 ] && when=now
if ! shutdown "$flag" "$when" "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "shutdown refused to schedule the $what."
  exit 1
fi
echo "Scheduled: $what $( [ "$delay" -eq 0 ] && echo now || echo "in $delay minute(s)" )."

# notify whoever sits at the screen; the dialog gives up by itself and never blocks this script
user=$(stat -f%Su /dev/console 2>/dev/null)
case "$user" in '' | root | loginwindow | _mbsetupuser) echo "No console user to notify." ;;
*)
  uid=$(id -u "$user" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$uid" ]; then
    launchctl asuser "$uid" sudo -u "$user" osascript \
      -e 'on run argv' \
      -e 'display dialog (item 1 of argv) with title "Notice" buttons {"OK"} default button 1 giving up after 120' \
      -e 'end run' -- "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    echo "Message sent to $user."
  fi
  ;;
esac
exit 0

variables.help: Restart, shut down, or cancel a pending shutdown.
variables.name: MODE
variables.label: Action

variables.help: 0 to 1440. 0 means now.
variables.name: DELAY_MINUTES
variables.label: Delay (minutes)

variables.help: Shown to the console user. Empty uses a standard text, up to 200 characters.
variables.name: MESSAGE
variables.label: Message

fields.name: Time Machine check
fields.description: Checks that a Time Machine backup exists and is recent. Reads the preferences, falls back to tmutil. Exit 3 when only Full Disk Access would give an answer.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Time Machine check. MAX_HOURS (48): oldest accepted age of the latest backup.
# Exit: 0 ok, 1 not configured, no backup or too old, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

max=${MAX_HOURS:-48}
prefs=/Library/Preferences/com.apple.TimeMachine

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
case "$max" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "MAX_HOURS must be a whole number."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$max" -ge 1 ] && [ "$max" -le 8760 ] || { echo "MAX_HOURS must be 1-8760."; exit 3; }

# The preferences list the backup dates (SnapshotDates, UTC; not AttemptDates) without Full Disk Access.
epoch=""
snap=$(defaults read "$prefs" 2>/dev/null | awk '/SnapshotDates = / { f = !/\)/; next } f && /\)/ { f = 0 } f' | grep -Eo '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} \+0000' | sort | tail -n 1)
if [ -n "$snap" ]; then
  epoch=$(date -j -u -f '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S +0000' "$snap" +%s 2>/dev/null)
fi

dest=$(tmutil destinationinfo 2>&1)
case "$dest" in
*"Full Disk Access"*)
  if [ -z "$epoch" ]; then
    echo "tmutil needs Full Disk Access for the agent and no snapshot dates are readable."
    echo "Grant it in System Settings > Privacy & Security, or deploy a PPPC profile."
    exit 3
  fi
  dest=""
  ;;
*"No destinations"*)
  echo "FAILING: Time Machine has no backup destination."
  exit 1
  ;;
esac

if [ -z "$epoch" ]; then
  last=$(tmutil latestbackup 2>&1)
  ts=$(echo "$last" | grep -Eo '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{6}' | tail -n 1)
  case "$last" in *"Full Disk Access"*) echo "tmutil needs Full Disk Access."; exit 3 ;; esac
  [ -n "$ts" ] && epoch=$(date -j -f '%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S' "$ts" +%s 2>/dev/null)
fi

if [ -z "$epoch" ]; then
  echo "FAILING: no completed backup found (the destination may be offline)."
  [ -n "$dest" ] && echo "$dest" | grep -E '^(Name|Kind|URL|Mount Point)' | head -n 4
  exit 1
fi

age=$(($(date +%s) - epoch))
hours=$((age / 3600))
when=$(date -r "$epoch" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
if [ "$hours" -ge "$max" ]; then
  echo "FAILING: last backup $when, $hours h ago, limit is $max h"
  exit 1
fi
echo "OK: last backup $when, $hours h ago, limit is $max h"
exit 0

variables.help: Oldest accepted age of the latest backup.
variables.name: MAX_HOURS
variables.label: Max age (hours)

fields.name: Uptime check
fields.description: Fails when the Mac has not been restarted for too long.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Uptime check. MAX_DAYS (30): longest accepted time since the last boot.
# Exit: 0 ok, 1 uptime above MAX_DAYS, 3 bad input or not macOS.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

max=${MAX_DAYS:-30}

[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || { echo "Not macOS."; exit 3; }
case "$max" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "MAX_DAYS must be a whole number."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$max" -ge 1 ] && [ "$max" -le 3650 ] || { echo "MAX_DAYS must be 1-3650."; exit 3; }

boot=$(sysctl -n kern.boottime 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^{ sec = \([0-9]*\),.*/\1/p')
case "$boot" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "Could not read the boot time."; exit 3 ;; esac
now=$(date +%s)
secs=$((now - boot))
days=$((secs / 86400))
hours=$((secs % 86400 / 3600))
since=$(date -r "$boot" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')

if [ "$days" -ge "$max" ]; then
  echo "FAILING: up $days days $hours h, limit is $max days (booted $since)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "OK: up $days days $hours h, limit is $max days (booted $since)"
exit 0

variables.help: Longest accepted time since the last boot.
variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Max uptime (days)

fields.name: Connectivity test
fields.description: Pings hosts, or opens a TCP connection when a port is given, and optionally resolves a name. Exit 1 when any check fails.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Connectivity test. TARGETS: host or host:port, one per line or comma separated (ping, or TCP connect with a port). DNS_NAME: optional name to resolve.
# Exit: 0 all reachable, 1 something failed, 3 bad input or not macOS.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

targets=$(printf '%s' "${TARGETS:-}" | tr ',' '\n')
dnsname=${DNS_NAME:-}

[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || { echo "Not macOS."; exit 3; }
hostre='^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9.-]{0,251}[A-Za-z0-9])?$'
if [ -n "$dnsname" ]; then
  ok "$dnsname" "$hostre" || { echo "DNS_NAME is not a valid host name."; exit 3; }
fi

list=""
n=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  line=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [ -n "$line" ] || continue
  host=${line%%:*}
  port=""
  case "$line" in *:*) port=${line#*:} ;; esac
  ok "$host" "$hostre" || { echo "Bad target: $line"; exit 3; }
  if [ -n "$port" ]; then
    case "$port" in *[!0-9]*) echo "Bad port in: $line"; exit 3 ;; esac
    [ "$port" -ge 1 ] && [ "$port" -le 65535 ] || { echo "Bad port in: $line"; exit 3; }
  fi
  n=$((n + 1))
  [ $n -le 50 ] || { echo "At most 50 targets."; exit 3; }
  list="$list$host $port
"
done <<EOT
$targets
EOT
[ -n "$list" ] || [ -n "$dnsname" ] || { echo "Give TARGETS or DNS_NAME."; exit 3; }

fail=0
total=0
details=""
if [ -n "$dnsname" ]; then
  total=$((total + 1))
  if dscacheutil -q host -a name "$dnsname" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^ip'; then
    details="${details}ok   resolve $dnsname
"
  else
    details="${details}FAIL resolve $dnsname
"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
fi
while read -r host port; do
  [ -n "$host" ] || continue
  total=$((total + 1))
  if [ -n "$port" ]; then
    if nc -z -G 5 "$host" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      details="${details}ok   $host:$port
"
    else
      details="${details}FAIL $host:$port
"
      fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi
  else
    if ping -c 2 -t 6 "$host" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      details="${details}ok   ping $host
"
    else
      details="${details}FAIL ping $host
"
      fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi
  fi
done <<EOT
$list
EOT

if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then echo "OK: $total of $total checks passed"; else echo "FAILING: $fail of $total checks failed"; fi
printf '%s' "$details"
[ $fail -eq 0 ]

variables.help: host or host:port, one per line or comma separated, up to 50.
variables.name: TARGETS
variables.label: Targets

variables.help: Optional host name that must resolve.
variables.name: DNS_NAME
variables.label: Name to resolve

fields.name: DNS report
fields.description: Resolvers and search domains from scutil --dns plus test lookups. Exit 2 when some lookups fail, 1 when none work or no resolver is set.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# DNS report: resolvers and search domains from scutil --dns, plus test lookups. No variables.
# Exit: 0 resolvers present and lookups work, 1 no resolver or all lookups failed, 2 some lookups failed, 3 not macOS.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || { echo "Not macOS."; exit 3; }

dns=$(scutil --dns 2>/dev/null)
ns=$(echo "$dns" | sed -n 's/^ *nameserver\[[0-9]*\] : //p' | sort -u)
search=$(echo "$dns" | sed -n 's/^ *search domain\[[0-9]*\] : //p' | sort -u)

ok=0
fail=0
res=""
for name in apple.com example.com; do
  if dscacheutil -q host -a name "$name" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^ip'; then
    res="${res}lookup $name: ok
"
    ok=$((ok + 1))
  else
    res="${res}lookup $name: FAILED
"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
done

rc=0
if [ -z "$ns" ]; then
  rc=1
  echo "FAILING: no nameserver configured"
elif [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "OK: all $ok test lookups work"
elif [ $ok -eq 0 ]; then
  rc=1
  echo "FAILING: no test lookup works"
else
  rc=2
  echo "WARNING: $fail of $((ok + fail)) test lookups failed"
fi
echo "Nameservers: $(echo "$ns" | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "Search domains: $(echo "$search" | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "Resolvers: $(echo "$dns" | grep -c '^resolver #')"
printf '%s' "$res"
exit $rc

fields.name: Wi-Fi report
fields.description: Interface, power, SSID, signal and security of the Wi-Fi link. The SSID is hidden by macOS privacy rules on recent versions and the report says so.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Wi-Fi report: interface, power, SSID where readable, signal, security. No variables.
# Exit: 0 reported, 3 no Wi-Fi interface, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

dev=$(networksetup -listallhardwareports 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Hardware Port: Wi-Fi/ {f = 1; next} f && /^Device:/ {print $2; exit}')
[ -n "$dev" ] || { echo "No Wi-Fi interface."; exit 3; }
echo "Interface: $dev"
echo "Power: $(networksetup -getairportpower "$dev" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*: //')"

info=$(wdutil info 2>/dev/null)
# first match of "key : value" inside the report
wf() { echo "$info" | awk -F' : ' -v k="$1" '{ key = $1; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", key) } key == k { print $2; exit }'; }
ssid=$(wf SSID)
rssi=$(wf RSSI)
sec=$(wf Security)
if [ -z "$info" ]; then
  sp=$(system_profiler SPAirPortDataType 2>/dev/null | awk '/Current Network Information:/ {f = 1; next} f')
  ssid=$(echo "$sp" | sed -n '1s/^ *\(.*\):$/\1/p')
  rssi=$(echo "$sp" | sed -n 's/^ *Signal \/ Noise: \(-[0-9]*\) dBm.*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  sec=$(echo "$sp" | sed -n 's/^ *Security: //p' | head -n 1)
fi

if [ -z "$ssid$rssi" ]; then
  echo "Not associated to a network."
  exit 0
fi
case "$ssid" in
'' | *redacted*) echo "SSID: hidden by macOS privacy rules (location permission is not available to the agent)" ;;
*) echo "SSID: $ssid" ;;
esac
[ -n "$rssi" ] && echo "Signal: $rssi"
[ -n "$sec" ] && echo "Security: $sec"
for k in Channel "Tx Rate" "Link Quality"; do
  v=$(wf "$k")
  [ -n "$v" ] && echo "$k: $v"
done
exit 0

fields.name: Application firewall
fields.description: Shows or sets the application firewall. Exit 1 when it is off in status mode or a change did not take effect (a managed profile can enforce the setting).
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Application firewall. STATE: status (default), on, off. STEALTH (false): with STATE=on also turn stealth mode on.
# Exit: 0 ok or reached, 1 firewall off in status mode or change not applied, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

state=${STATE:-status}
stealth=${STEALTH:-false}
fw=/usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
case "$state" in status | on | off) ;; *) echo "STATE must be status, on or off."; exit 3 ;; esac
case "$stealth" in true | false) ;; *) echo "STEALTH must be true or false."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ -x "$fw" ] || { echo "$fw not found."; exit 3; }

fw_on() { "$fw" --getglobalstate 2>&1 | grep -qi "enabled"; }
stealth_on() { "$fw" --getstealthmode 2>&1 | grep -Eqi "mode (is )?(on|enabled)"; }

rc=0
case "$state" in
on)
  if fw_on; then echo "Firewall was already on."; else "$fw" --setglobalstate on >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
  if [ "$stealth" = true ]; then
    if stealth_on; then echo "Stealth mode was already on."; else "$fw" --setstealthmode on >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
  fi
  fw_on || { echo "Firewall is still off (a managed profile may enforce it)."; rc=1; }
  if [ "$stealth" = true ] && ! stealth_on; then echo "Stealth mode is still off."; rc=1; fi
  ;;
off)
  if fw_on; then "$fw" --setglobalstate off >/dev/null 2>&1; else echo "Firewall was already off."; fi
  if fw_on; then echo "Firewall is still on (a managed profile may enforce it)."; rc=1; fi
  ;;
esac

if fw_on; then echo "Firewall: on"; else echo "Firewall: off"; [ "$state" = status ] && rc=1; fi
if stealth_on; then echo "Stealth mode: on"; else echo "Stealth mode: off"; fi
"$fw" --getblockall 2>&1 | head -n 1
exit $rc

variables.help: Status only, turn the firewall on, or turn it off.
variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action

variables.help: With Action on: also turn stealth mode on. Never turns it off.
variables.name: STEALTH
variables.label: Stealth mode

fields.name: FileVault status
fields.description: Reports whether FileVault disk encryption is on. Exit 0 on, 2 while encrypting or decrypting, 1 off.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# FileVault status. No variables.
# Exit: 0 on, 1 off, 2 encryption or decryption in progress, 3 not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

out=$(fdesetup status 2>&1)
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ -z "$out" ]; then
  echo "fdesetup failed with exit code $rc."
  exit 1
fi

case "$out" in
*"Decryption in progress"* | *"Encryption in progress"*)
  echo "FileVault is changing state."
  echo "$out"
  exit 2
  ;;
*"FileVault is On"*)
  echo "FileVault is on."
  echo "$out" | sed -n '2,$p'
  exit 0
  ;;
*"FileVault is Off"*)
  echo "FileVault is off."
  echo "$out" | sed -n '2,$p'
  exit 1
  ;;
esac
echo "FileVault state could not be read."
echo "$out"
exit 3

fields.name: Remote Login (SSH)
fields.description: Shows or sets Remote Login. Uses systemsetup and falls back to launchctl when the agent lacks Full Disk Access. Exit 1 when the wanted state is not reached.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Remote Login (SSH). STATE: status (default), on, off.
# Exit: 0 ok, 1 state not reached, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

state=${STATE:-status}
label=com.openssh.sshd
plist=/System/Library/LaunchDaemons/ssh.plist

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
case "$state" in status | on | off) ;; *) echo "STATE must be status, on or off."; exit 3 ;; esac

# prints on or off: on means sshd is loaded in launchd and accepts connections
current() {
  if launchctl print "system/$label" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo on; else echo off; fi
}

before=$(current)
if [ "$state" = status ]; then
  echo "Remote Login: $before"
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$before" = "$state" ]; then
  echo "Remote Login was already $state."
  # a launchd override that disagrees would flip it at the next restart
  ov=$(launchctl print-disabled system 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/.*\"$label\" => //p")
  if [ "$state" = on ] && [ "$ov" = disabled ]; then
    launchctl enable "system/$label" && echo "Also enabled it in launchd so it stays on after a restart."
  elif [ "$state" = off ] && [ "$ov" = enabled ]; then
    launchctl disable "system/$label" && echo "Also disabled it in launchd so it stays off after a restart."
  fi
  exit 0
fi

out=$(systemsetup -f -setremotelogin "$state" 2>&1)
case "$(current)" in
"$state") ;;
*)
  echo "systemsetup did not apply it (Full Disk Access is probably missing); using launchctl."
  if [ "$state" = on ]; then
    launchctl enable "system/$label" >/dev/null 2>&1
    launchctl bootstrap system "$plist" >/dev/null 2>&1
  else
    launchctl bootout "system/$label" >/dev/null 2>&1
    launchctl disable "system/$label" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  ;;
esac

after=$(current)
if [ "$after" = "$state" ]; then
  echo "Remote Login set to $state (was $before)."
  exit 0
fi
echo "Remote Login is $after, wanted $state. A managed profile may control it."
echo "$out" | head -n 3
exit 1

variables.help: Status only, turn Remote Login on, or turn it off.
variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action
