fields.name: Command Line Tools install
fields.description: Installs the Command Line Tools through the softwareupdate placeholder method. Does nothing when they are installed.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Install the Command Line Tools through softwareupdate. No variables.
# Exit: 0 installed or already present, 1 install failed or no package offered, 3 not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

if [ -x /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/git ] && pkgutil --pkg-info=com.apple.pkg.CLTools_Executables >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Command Line Tools already installed ($(pkgutil --pkg-info=com.apple.pkg.CLTools_Executables | sed -n 's/^version: //p'))."
  exit 0
fi

# The placeholder makes softwareupdate list the tools as an update.
flag=/tmp/.com.apple.dt.CommandLineTools.installondemand.in-progress
trap 'rm -f "$flag"' EXIT
touch "$flag"

list=$(softwareupdate -l 2>&1)
label=$(echo "$list" | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\* \(Label: \)\{0,1\}\(Command Line Tools.*\)$/\2/p' | tail -n 1)
if [ -z "$label" ]; then
  echo "softwareupdate offers no Command Line Tools package."
  echo "$list" | tail -n 3
  exit 1
fi
echo "Installing: $label"
if softwareupdate -i "$label" 2>&1 | tail -n 5; then
  if [ -x /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/git ]; then
    echo "Command Line Tools installed."
    exit 0
  fi
fi
echo "Command Line Tools are not installed."
exit 1

fields.name: Homebrew outdated report
fields.description: Lists outdated formulae and casks of /opt/homebrew and /usr/local, run as the owner of each installation. Report only, no update.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Homebrew outdated report for /opt/homebrew and /usr/local, run as the owner of each installation. Report only.
# Exit: 0 report printed, 3 no usable Homebrew, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

found=0
for prefix in /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
  brew=$prefix/bin/brew
  [ -x "$brew" ] || continue
  owner=$(stat -Lf%Su "$brew" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$owner" in '' | root)
    echo "$prefix: owned by root, Homebrew refuses to run as root, skipped."
    continue
    ;;
  esac
  found=1
  echo "== $prefix (user $owner)"
  out=$(cd / && sudo -u "$owner" -H env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin HOME="$(dscl . -read "/Users/$owner" NFSHomeDirectory 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^NFSHomeDirectory: //')" \
    HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_ANALYTICS=1 HOMEBREW_NO_ENV_HINTS=1 "$brew" outdated --verbose 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ -z "$out" ]; then
    echo "brew failed with exit code $rc."
  elif [ -z "$out" ]; then
    echo "Nothing outdated."
  else
    echo "$out" | head -n 200
  fi
done

if [ $found -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No Homebrew installation owned by a user was found."
  exit 3
fi
echo "Based on the last brew update of each user; this report does not run brew update."
exit 0

fields.name: Rosetta install
fields.description: Installs Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon through softwareupdate. Exit 3 on Intel Macs.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Install Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon. No variables.
# Exit: 0 installed or already present, 1 install failed, 3 Intel Mac, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
# uname -m lies when this shell runs under Rosetta itself
if [ "$(sysctl -n hw.optional.arm64 2>/dev/null)" != 1 ]; then
  echo "Not an Apple silicon Mac, Rosetta does not apply."
  exit 3
fi

if [ -f /Library/Apple/usr/libexec/oah/libRosettaRuntime ] || pgrep -qx oahd; then
  echo "Rosetta is already installed."
  exit 0
fi

if softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license 2>&1 | tail -n 5; then
  if [ -f /Library/Apple/usr/libexec/oah/libRosettaRuntime ]; then
    echo "Rosetta installed."
    exit 0
  fi
fi
echo "Rosetta is not installed. Check the network and that no profile blocks Apple software downloads."
exit 1

fields.name: Computer name
fields.description: Shows or sets ComputerName, LocalHostName and HostName. The host names are reduced to letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Computer name. NAME: new name, empty reports the current names. Sets ComputerName as given and
# LocalHostName and HostName in a hostname-safe form (letters, digits, hyphen, up to 63).
# Exit: 0 reported or set, 1 change failed, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

name=${NAME:-}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

show() {
  echo "ComputerName: $(scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "LocalHostName: $(scutil --get LocalHostName 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "HostName: $(scutil --get HostName 2>/dev/null)"
}

if [ -z "$name" ]; then
  show
  exit 0
fi

ok "$name" "^[A-Za-z0-9 ._'-]{1,63}\$" || { echo "NAME must be 1-63 characters: letters, digits, space and . _ ' -"; exit 3; }
host=$(printf '%s' "$name" | tr -cs 'A-Za-z0-9' '-' | sed 's/^-*//; s/-*$//' | cut -c1-63 | sed 's/-*$//')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "NAME has no letter or digit to build a host name from."; exit 3; }

rc=0
set_one() { # key value
  if [ "$(scutil --get "$1" 2>/dev/null)" = "$2" ]; then
    echo "$1 already $2"
  elif scutil --set "$1" "$2"; then
    echo "$1 set to $2"
  else
    echo "$1 could not be set"
    rc=1
  fi
}
set_one ComputerName "$name"
set_one LocalHostName "$host"
set_one HostName "$host"
dscacheutil -flushcache >/dev/null 2>&1
exit $rc

variables.help: Empty only reports the current names. Up to 63 characters.
variables.name: NAME
variables.label: New name

fields.name: Time zone
fields.description: Shows or sets the time zone. Warns when automatic time zone by location is on.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Time zone. TIMEZONE: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin, empty reports the current one.
# Exit: 0 reported or set, 1 change failed, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

tz=${TIMEZONE:-}
zones=/var/db/timezone/zoneinfo

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

current=$(readlink /etc/localtime 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*/zoneinfo/||')
auto=$(defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.timezone.auto Active 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$tz" ]; then
  echo "Time zone: ${current:-unknown}"
  echo "Set automatically by location: $([ "$auto" = 1 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  exit 0
fi

ok "$tz" '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+/-]{1,59}$' || { echo "TIMEZONE has characters outside A-Z a-z 0-9 _ + - /"; exit 3; }
[ -f "$zones/$tz" ] || { echo "Unknown time zone $tz (examples: Europe/Berlin, America/New_York, UTC)."; exit 3; }

if [ "$current" = "$tz" ]; then
  echo "Time zone already $tz."
  exit 0
fi

if ! systemsetup -settimezone "$tz" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(readlink /etc/localtime | sed 's|.*/zoneinfo/||')" != "$tz" ]; then
  # systemsetup needs Full Disk Access; this is the same link it writes
  ln -sfn "$zones/$tz" /etc/localtime
fi
now=$(readlink /etc/localtime | sed 's|.*/zoneinfo/||')
if [ "$now" != "$tz" ]; then
  echo "Time zone is $now, wanted $tz."
  exit 1
fi
echo "Time zone set to $tz (was ${current:-unknown})."
[ "$auto" = 1 ] && echo "Warning: automatic time zone by location is on and can change it again."
exit 0

variables.help: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. Empty only reports the current one.
variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.label: Time zone

fields.name: Administrator rights
fields.description: Grants or revokes administrator rights of a local user. Refuses to remove the last enabled administrator.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Grant or revoke administrator rights. TARGET_USER, STATE: grant or revoke.
# Refuses to revoke the last enabled local administrator.
# Exit: 0 done or already in place, 1 change failed, 3 bad input, refused, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

user=${TARGET_USER:-}
state=${STATE:-}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
ok "$user" '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,30}$' || { echo "TARGET_USER is empty or has characters outside A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -"; exit 3; }
case "$state" in grant | revoke) ;; *) echo "STATE must be grant or revoke."; exit 3 ;; esac

uid=$(dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
case "$uid" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "No local user $user."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$uid" -ge 500 ] || { echo "$user is a system account, refusing."; exit 3; }

is_admin() { dseditgroup -o checkmember -m "$1" admin >/dev/null 2>&1; }

if [ "$state" = grant ]; then
  if is_admin "$user"; then echo "$user is already an administrator."; exit 0; fi
  dseditgroup -o edit -a "$user" -t user admin || { echo "Granting failed."; exit 1; }
  is_admin "$user" && { echo "$user is now an administrator."; exit 0; }
  echo "Granting did not take effect."
  exit 1
fi

if ! is_admin "$user"; then echo "$user is not an administrator."; exit 0; fi
others=0
for m in $(dscl . -read /Groups/admin GroupMembership 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^GroupMembership://'); do
  [ "$m" = "$user" ] && continue
  mu=$(dscl . -read "/Users/$m" UniqueID 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
  case "$mu" in '' | *[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
  [ "$mu" -ge 500 ] || continue
  dscl . -read "/Users/$m" AuthenticationAuthority 2>/dev/null | grep -q ';DisabledUser;' && continue
  others=$((others + 1))
done
if [ "$others" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "$user is the last enabled local administrator, not revoking."
  exit 3
fi
dseditgroup -o edit -d "$user" -t user admin || { echo "Revoking failed."; exit 1; }
is_admin "$user" && { echo "Revoking did not take effect."; exit 1; }
echo "$user is no longer an administrator."
exit 0

variables.help: Local account.
variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Short name

variables.help: Grant or revoke administrator rights.
variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action

fields.name: Console user collector
fields.description: Prints the short name of the user at the screen, or none. The last line is the value.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Console user collector. No variables. The last line is the short name or "none".
# Exit: 0 always, 3 not macOS.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || { echo "Not macOS."; exit 3; }

fields.name: Create user
fields.description: Creates a local user with sysadminctl and reads the password from stdin. The account gets no Secure Token unless it is the first one. Does nothing when the user exists.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Create a local user. TARGET_USER, FULL_NAME, PASSWORD (read by sysadminctl from stdin), ADMINISTRATOR (false).
# The new account gets no Secure Token unless it is the first one; that needs the credentials of an existing
# token holder, which this script does not take.
# Exit: 0 created or already there, 1 creation failed, 3 bad input, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

user=${TARGET_USER:-}
full=${FULL_NAME:-}
pass=${PASSWORD:-}
admin=${ADMINISTRATOR:-false}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
ok "$user" '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]{0,30}$' || { echo "TARGET_USER must be 1-31 characters: a-z, 0-9, _ . - and not start with a digit."; exit 3; }
[ -n "$full" ] || full=$user
ok "$full" "^[A-Za-z0-9 ._'-]{1,60}\$" || { echo "FULL_NAME must be 1-60 characters: letters, digits, space and . _ ' -"; exit 3; }
[ ${#pass} -ge 8 ] && [ ${#pass} -le 128 ] || { echo "PASSWORD must be 8-128 characters."; exit 3; }
case "$pass" in *[[:cntrl:]]*) echo "PASSWORD must not contain control characters or line breaks."; exit 3 ;; esac
case "$admin" in true | false) ;; *) echo "ADMINISTRATOR must be true or false."; exit 3 ;; esac

if dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "User $user already exists, nothing changed."
  exit 0
fi

args=(-addUser "$user" -fullName "$full" -password -)
[ "$admin" = true ] && args+=(-admin)
out=$(printf '%s\n' "$pass" | sysadminctl "${args[@]}" 2>&1)

if ! dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sysadminctl did not create the account."
  echo "$out" | grep -vi 'password' | head -n 5
  exit 1
fi
# no password hash, or an empty password that works, means the stdin password was not taken
if ! dscl . -read "/Users/$user" AuthenticationAuthority 2>/dev/null | grep -q ShadowHash ||
  dscl . -authonly "$user" "" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sysadminctl -deleteUser "$user" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "The account was created without the password (sysadminctl did not read it from stdin) and could not be removed. Delete $user by hand."
  else
    echo "The account was created without the password (sysadminctl did not read it from stdin) and was removed again."
  fi
  exit 1
fi

tok=$(sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus "$user" 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*Secure token is \([A-Z]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
echo "User $user created (administrator: $admin)."
echo "Secure Token: ${tok:-unknown}. Without one the user cannot unlock FileVault at the login window."
exit 0

variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, _ . -, up to 31 characters.
variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Short name

variables.help: Letters, digits, space and . _ ' -. Empty uses the short name.
variables.name: FULL_NAME
variables.label: Full name

variables.help: 8 to 128 characters. Visible in the run history of this task.
variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password

variables.help: Add the user to the admin group.

fields.name: Users list
fields.description: Lists local accounts with UID, admin rights, Secure Token state, disabled flag and last login.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# List local user accounts with admin rights, Secure Token state, last login. No variables.
# Exit: 0 listed, 3 not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }

admins=" $(dscl . -read /Groups/admin GroupMembership 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^GroupMembership://') "
count=0
printf '%-20s %-5s %-6s %-9s %-8s %s\n' USER UID ADMIN TOKEN DISABLED LAST_LOGIN
while read -r name uid; do
  case "$name" in '' | _*) continue ;; esac
  case "$uid" in '' | *[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
  [ "$uid" -ge 500 ] || continue
  adm=no
  case "$admins" in *" $name "*) adm=yes ;; esac
  tok=$(sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus "$name" 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*Secure token is \([A-Z]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$tok" ] || tok=unknown
  dis=no
  dscl . -read "/Users/$name" AuthenticationAuthority 2>/dev/null | grep -q ';DisabledUser;' && dis=yes
  last=$(last -1 "$name" 2>/dev/null | sed -n "1s/^$name  *//p" | sed 's/  */ /g')
  [ -n "$last" ] || last=never
  printf '%-20s %-5s %-6s %-9s %-8s %s\n' "$name" "$uid" "$adm" "$tok" "$dis" "$last"
  count=$((count + 1))
done < <(dscl . -list /Users UniqueID)
echo "$count local accounts."
exit 0

fields.name: Rotate local admin password
fields.description: Rotates the password of a local administrator account and creates it when missing. Uses chpasswd on stdin; new accounts join sudo or wheel. Refuses locked and system accounts.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/sh
# Rotates the password of a local administrator account, creating it when missing (password goes to chpasswd on stdin).
# Variables: TARGET_USER (required), NEW_PASSWORD (required, 8-128 characters), CREATE_IF_MISSING (checkbox, default true).
# Exit codes: 0 password set, 1 failed, 3 bad input, locked account or system account.
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
set -u

command -v awk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "awk not found: install gawk"; exit 3; }
[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "Needs root"; exit 3; }

u=${TARGET_USER:-}
pw=${NEW_PASSWORD:-}
create=${CREATE_IF_MISSING:-true}
[ -n "$u" ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is required"; exit 3; }
case $u in [!a-z]* | *[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo "TARGET_USER must match [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,19}"; exit 3 ;; esac
[ ${#u} -le 20 ] || { echo "TARGET_USER is longer than 20 characters"; exit 3; }
[ ${#pw} -ge 8 ] && [ ${#pw} -le 128 ] || { echo "NEW_PASSWORD must be 8-128 characters"; exit 3; }
case $pw in *"
"*) echo "NEW_PASSWORD must not contain a line break"; exit 3 ;; esac
case $create in true | false) ;; *) echo "CREATE_IF_MISSING must be true or false"; exit 3 ;; esac
command -v chpasswd >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "chpasswd not found"; exit 3; }

umin=$(awk '$1=="UID_MIN" {print $2}' /etc/login.defs 2>/dev/null)
case $umin in '' | *[!0-9]*) umin=1000 ;; esac

ent=$(getent passwd "$u") || ent=""
created=no
# a half-created account must not survive a failed run
undo() {
  [ "$created" = yes ] || return 0
  if command -v userdel >/dev/null 2>&1; then userdel -r "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; else deluser --remove-home "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
}
if [ -z "$ent" ]; then
  [ "$create" = true ] || { echo "User $u does not exist"; exit 3; }
  grp=""
  for g in sudo wheel; do
    if getent group "$g" >/dev/null 2>&1; then grp=$g; break; fi
  done
  [ -n "$grp" ] || { echo "No sudo or wheel group to put $u in"; exit 3; }
  if command -v useradd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    useradd -m -s /bin/sh -G "$grp" "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "useradd failed"; exit 1; }
    created=yes
  elif command -v adduser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if adduser -D -s /bin/sh "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      created=yes
      addgroup "$u" "$grp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { undo; echo "addgroup failed"; exit 1; }
    else
      echo "adduser failed"
      exit 1
    fi
  else
    echo "Neither useradd nor adduser found"
    exit 3
  fi
  created=yes
  ent=$(getent passwd "$u") || { undo; echo "User $u missing after creation"; exit 1; }
fi

uid=$(echo "$ent" | cut -d: -f3)
if [ "$uid" -lt "$umin" ] || [ "$uid" -ge 65534 ]; then
  echo "Refusing to rotate $u: uid $uid is a system account"
  undo
  exit 3
fi
before=$(awk -F: -v u="$u" '$1==u {print $2}' /etc/shadow)
if [ "$created" = no ]; then
  case $before in '!'?* | '*'?*) echo "Refusing to rotate $u: the account is locked"; exit 3 ;; esac
fi

printf '%s:%s\n' "$u" "$pw" | chpasswd >/dev/null 2>&1 || { undo; echo "chpasswd failed"; exit 1; }
after=$(awk -F: -v u="$u" '$1==u {print $2}' /etc/shadow)
case $after in '' | '!'* | '*'*) echo "Password for $u is still not usable after the change"; undo; exit 1 ;; esac
[ "$after" != "$before" ] || { echo "Password hash unchanged"; undo; exit 1; }
echo "Password for $u rotated, created=$created"
exit 0

fields.name: Rotate local admin password
fields.description: Rotates a local administrator password, creates the account when missing. Secure token caveat: an account holding a secure token may need a token-holding admin, then the rotation fails.
fields.script_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Rotates the password of a local administrator account, creating it when missing. The password never appears in argv.
# Variables: TARGET_USER (required), NEW_PASSWORD (required, 8-128 characters), CREATE_IF_MISSING (checkbox, default true).
# Exit: 0 password set, 1 failed, 3 bad input, system account, not macOS or not root.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
set -u

ok() { case "$1" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq "$2"; }

user=${TARGET_USER:-}
pw=${NEW_PASSWORD:-}
create=${CREATE_IF_MISSING:-true}

{ [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; } || { echo "Needs macOS and root."; exit 3; }
ok "$user" '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,19}$' || { echo "TARGET_USER must match [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,19}"; exit 3; }
[ ${#pw} -ge 8 ] && [ ${#pw} -le 128 ] || { echo "NEW_PASSWORD must be 8-128 characters"; exit 3; }
case "$pw" in *$'\n'*) echo "NEW_PASSWORD must not contain a line break"; exit 3 ;; esac
case "$create" in true | false) ;; *) echo "CREATE_IF_MISSING must be true or false"; exit 3 ;; esac

uid=$(dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
created=no
if [ -z "$uid" ]; then
  [ "$create" = true ] || { echo "No local user $user."; exit 3; }
  # sysadminctl reads the new password from stdin with "-password -"
  printf '%s\n' "$pw" | sysadminctl -addUser "$user" -fullName "$user" -password - -admin >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || { dscl . -read "/Users/$user" >/dev/null 2>&1 && dscl . -delete "/Users/$user" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "sysadminctl -addUser failed."; exit 1; }
  uid=$(dscl . -read "/Users/$user" UniqueID 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
  case "$uid" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "User $user missing after creation."; exit 1 ;; esac
  created=yes
fi
case "$uid" in *[!0-9]*) echo "No local user $user."; exit 3 ;; esac
[ "$uid" -ge 500 ] || { echo "$user is a system account, refusing."; exit 3; }

if [ "$created" = no ]; then
  if dscl . -read "/Users/$user" AuthenticationAuthority 2>/dev/null | grep -q ';DisabledUser;'; then
    echo "Refusing to rotate $user: the account is disabled."
    exit 3
  fi
  # sysadminctl reads the password from stdin for "-newPassword -"; the fallback feeds dscl's
  # interactive mode on stdin, which only takes passwords without blanks, quotes or backslashes
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$pw" | sysadminctl -resetPasswordFor "$user" -newPassword - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    case "$pw" in
    *[[:space:]\"\'\\]*) echo "sysadminctl -resetPasswordFor failed."; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    printf 'passwd /Users/%s %s\n' "$user" "$pw" | dscl . >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || { echo "sysadminctl and dscl password reset failed."; exit 1; }
  fi
fi
echo "Password for $user rotated, created=$created"
exit 0
